name: AI Agents Live

sources.title: Homepage — live AI agents directory with reviews/ratings, 50+ categories, recent activity Sep 2026
Submit an AI Agent — 4-step form; step 1 asks website URL, email, name; 'We only accept AI agents and AI platform listings. NSFW content is not allowed'

requirements: Only AI agents and AI platform listings accepted
4-step submission flow starting with website URL, email, and name (no sign-in required at step 1)
preparation: Website URL, contact email (listing updates go there), and your name
Likely in later steps: description, category pick from ~50 categories, logo
Product must genuinely be an AI agent or AI platform
workflow: Open https://aiagentslive.com/agents/products/new ('Submit Your AI Agent' in nav)
Step 1: enter website URL, email, and name
Complete steps 2–4 (product details; not visible without proceeding)
Listing goes live at /agents/<id>.<slug> after review and can collect user ratings/reviews
watchFor: Only step 1 of the form is publicly visible — pricing/free status and later fields are unverified
Listings carry public ratings and reviews — live products can accumulate scores
Outbound links are utm-tagged referral links (utm_source=aiagentslive.com) — link-juice value unclear
Site also sells services ('talk to us' Calendly) — distinguish listing from consulting upsell
countsAsLive: The agent has a public page at aiagentslive.com/agents/<id>.<slug> reachable from a category page
unknowns: Whether the listing is free or paid — nothing about cost before step 2
